name: toast-js-build-poc-tsdown
description: Isolated tsdown proof of concept for the Toast-JS modernization.

scripts.build: npm run build:dist && npm run build:min
scripts.build:dist: POC_TARGET=index POC_MIN=0 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs && POC_TARGET=modules POC_MIN=0 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs && POC_TARGET=browser POC_MIN=0 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs
scripts.build:min: POC_TARGET=index POC_MIN=1 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs && POC_TARGET=modules POC_MIN=1 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs && POC_TARGET=browser POC_MIN=1 tsdown -c tsdown.config.mjs
